name: XOS Developers
tagline: Build on the XOS public API: guides, the API reference, SDKs, the CLI, the MCP server and self-hosting.

home.title: Build on XOS
home.sentence: One API serves Atlas, Gateway, Compass and your integrations. Start with a guide, look up an operation, or find help for the apps.
home.guidesBody: Authenticate, page and filter, write safely, handle refusals, receive webhooks and self-host.
home.referenceBody: Every operation in the OpenAPI document, with parameters, schemas and code samples.
home.helpBody: How Atlas works, page by page, in the same articles the in-app help panel shows.

guides.title: Guides
guides.sentence: Everything you need to build on the public API, from the first request to running your own deployment.

reference.title: API reference
reference.sentence: {count} operations across {resources} resources, generated from the OpenAPI document version {version}.
reference.idempotent: Send an Idempotency-Key header. A replay with the same key returns the original response.
reference.ifMatch: Send If-Match with the ETag you read. A stale tag returns 412; a missing tag returns 428.
reference.paged: Cursor-paginated: limit, cursor, fields, sort and filter apply.
reference.errors: Error statuses: {statuses}. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details.

dictionary.title: Data dictionary
dictionary.sentence: {tables} tables and {views} views with {columns} columns, generated from the comments in the database schema.
dictionary.source: Every table and column carries a comment in its migration. CI regenerates this page from a freshly migrated database and fails when it differs, so it always matches the schema. Descriptions are in English, as the schema writes them.

schemas.app: Organizations' data and the platform's, with row level security on every table.
schemas.xpms: The canon: the XOS Bible and Playbook as published data, read-only.
schemas.api_external: Views for external parties in Gateway and Compass, with only the columns they may read.
schemas.api_public: Views the public token functions read without a sign-in.
